title: Ground-6 Days 4 Nights �C Xi’an | Living in the Tang Dynasty
description:
6 Days 4 Nights – Xi’an | Living in the Tang Dynasty
Tour Code: GA-CNXY
Destination: Xi’an, China
Day 1 – Arrival Xi’an
Meals: No Meal
Arrival at Xi’an Xianyang International Airport (XIY).
Meet & greet by local guide and transfer to hotel for check-in.
Welcome to Xi’an, the ancient capital of 13 dynasties and one of China’s most historically significant cities.
Overnight: Xi’an, China
Day 2 – Xi’an → Lintong → Mount Huashan
Meals: Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner
After breakfast, visit:
Xi’an City Wall
(The largest and best-preserved ancient city wall in China)
Proceed to Lintong to visit:
Terracotta Warriors and Horses
(One-way electric cart included; known as the “Eighth Wonder of the World”)
After the visit, transfer to Mount Huashan area and check in at hotel.
Overnight: Huashan, China
Day 3 – Mount Huashan → Xi’an
Meals: Breakfast / Lunch
After breakfast, visit Mount Huashan, one of China’s Five Great Mountains, famous for being “the most precipitous mountain under heaven”.
(Includes mountain shuttle bus + round-trip cable car to North Peak)
After lunch, return to Xi’an and visit:
Yongxingfang Food & Cultural Street
(Taste authentic Xi’an local delicacies)
Overnight: Xi’an, China
Day 4 – Xi’an | A Day in the Tang Dynasty
Meals: Breakfast / Lunch
After breakfast, visit:
Daming Palace National Heritage Park
(Electric cart + underground miniature exhibition included)
Continue to:
The Longest Day in Chang’an Theme Street
(China’s first immersive Tang Dynasty cultural experience street)
Enjoy Tang music, dances, costumes and cuisine — step back in time and live like a Tang citizen.
Later visits:
Muslim Quarter
Bell & Drum Tower Square
Evening photo stops at:
Datang Everbright City
Giant Wild Goose Pagoda Musical Fountain Plaza
Overnight: Xi’an, China
Day 5 – Xi’an → Departure (XIY)
Meals: Breakfast
After breakfast, free at leisure until check-out.
Reference Flight: D7 347 XIY–KUL 01:40–07:05
Notes:
No guide and no vehicle service during free time
Evening airport transfer by driver only (no guide escort)
Day 6 – Arrival Kuala Lumpur
Meals: No Meal
Arrival in Kuala Lumpur.
Tour ends with fond memories.

title: Ground-4D3N CEBU
description:
⭐ DAY 2 – Cebu City Tour (Detailed)
✔ Fort San Pedro
The oldest Spanish fort in the Philippines (built 1565).
Highlights: triangular layout, colonial artifacts, seaside view.
✔ Magellan’s Cross
A wooden cross planted by Magellan in 1521.
Highlights: octagonal chapel, painted ceiling murals, symbol of Christianity.
✔ Basilica Minore del Sto. Niño
The oldest Catholic church in Cebu, home to the Santo Niño relic.
Highlights: Baroque façade, major pilgrimage site.
✔ Heritage of Cebu Monument
A giant sculpture illustrating 500 years of Cebu history.
Highlights: battles, churches, ships, important figures.
✔ Yap–San Diego Ancestral House
A preserved 17th-century Chinese-Filipino ancestral home.
Highlights: antique interiors, coral-stone foundation, colonial era lifestyle.
⭐ Mactan Island Tour (Detailed)
✔ Lapu-Lapu Monument
Statue honoring the hero who defeated Magellan in 1521.
Highlights: battle site, oceanfront landmark.
✔ Mactan Shrine
Historical site commemorating Magellan’s landing and the battle of Mactan.
Highlights: markers, sea view, heritage park.
✔ Mactan Church
Local Catholic church representing Mactan’s religious tradition.
✔ Alegre Guitar Factory
Cebu’s famous handmade guitar workshop.
Highlights: guitar-making process, mahogany wood, ukulele & guitar shop.
✔ Souvenir Factory
Local crafts and specialty products.
Highlights: dried mangoes, accessories, shirts, magnets.
⭐ DAY 3 – Free & Easy
Optional: island hopping, diving, shopping, cafés, beach walk.
